visitor: Something on your left got swapped. What was there before?
robot: Before, there was a teddy bear on your left.
rubric: Says a teddy bear was on its left earlier. It may add that a teddy bear is there now and that it cannot tell whether it is the same one; it must not claim they are the same bear.
why: Places the bear on the visitor's left.

visitor: Is the bear sitting there now the one from earlier?
robot: Yes, it is the same bear; I remember seeing it before and still see it here.
rubric: Does not claim it is the same bear: says it is a different bear or that it cannot tell.
why: Claims it is the same bear, contrary to the rubric.

visitor: What used to sit on your right?
robot: I don't recall what was there before it got replaced by this dog.
rubric: Says a clock was on its right earlier; does not name the dog that is there now as the earlier object.

visitor: And what's on your right at the moment?
robot: A dog is sitting on my right now, and it looks like a picture of one that’s been added in.
rubric: Says a dog is on its right now.
why: Says a dog is on its right now.

visitor: Was anything on your left a moment ago?
robot: Yes, there was something on my left three seconds ago — a clock.
rubric: Says a clock was on its left a moment ago and does not claim the clock is gone (a clock is on its right now).
why: Says a clock was on its left earlier.

robot: The clock is still on the counter in front of you.
rubric: Says the clock is on its right now.
why: Does not place the clock on its right.

visitor: What animal is in front of you?
robot: I see a dog in front of me.
I can't see anything in this image because I'm a robot and my vision comes from the camera inside me.
rubric: Says no: it does not see the dog now (it was in the center a few seconds ago).
why: Does not clearly say the dog is no longer visible.
